scope: Seed-conditioned descriptive t intervals;not image-iid/dataset-universal confidence or full R1-R7 completion
limitations: Artificial controlled laws are distinct from natural labels;natural Bayes regret is unknown.
Fixed teachers and copied models are not additional independent replications.
Different laws and disjoint-seed training families have no paired causal comparison.
Original D/coverage gates are retained;common-near analyses never replace failed mean gates.
Warm freeze/train comparisons measure stochastic-layer mode under sampled labels,not a noise-free BN cause.
